thread:
elaine_cs: Quick heads-up — prepping Altum EBR (exec readout) for next Wed. Need slide owners, 3 prioritized asks for execs, onboarding gaps, and a one-line renewal risk summary. I’ll collect pieces in this thread. Please keep replies short and tag owners.

Toby: I can own Onboarding & Adoption slide. Will pull activation metrics + top 3 blockers.

Arya: Assign me for Enablement + Demo flow. I’ll update the playbook and include two screenshots. Do we have the final demo video link?

Kevin: I’ll cover Renewal Risk & Commercial asks. Flag: usage dip in week 6. I’ll add renewal health score + proposed NRR ask. @toby_csm can you paste the churn-signal list?

elaine_cs: Thanks. @milo_prod can you add a one-slide perf summary (latency / cost) — a single chart or sparkline is fine. Paste dashboard link here when ready.

milo_prod: On it. Can export a PNG/chart by EOD. Quick Q: which model/route should I show — Hosted API or Dedicated?

kevin_sales: Hosted API — that’s what Altum runs in prod. But call out Dedicated as a recommended next step (trial).

arya_enablement: Also collecting enablement feedback from their CSAT survey and the last onboarding retro. @elaine_cs do we have permission to share verbatim quotes or should we paraphrase?

elaine_cs: You can include verbatim quotes but redact PII (names, emails). Add 1-2 short quote lines with sentiment labels and assign an action owner for each.

dev-bot: :robot_face: Reminder: create slide stub in #slides using template `EBR_one_pager_v2`. Command: `/create-slide Altum EBR_one_pager_v2`

Toby: Dropping onboarding metrics here (will paste full CSV to the drive):
```
activation_rate: 42%
week6_retention: 63%
avg_time_to_first_success: 4.2 days
error_rate: 1.2% of calls
```

elaine_cs: Perfect — couple of operational asks before I run the exec dry-run: 1) Consolidate final slide content into the shared doc by Tue 12:00pm PT. 2) I’ll run exec dry-run Tue 4:00pm PT — please be available or send a backup. 3) Add owners for any open asks inline (use @handles).

toby_csm: Confirmed available Tue 4pm. I’ll upload the CSV and a 1-slide onboarding summary.

arya_enablement: Confirmed. Will add enablement playbook changes + demo screenshots by Tue noon.

milo_prod: Confirmed. Chart + dashboard link by EOD today.

kevin_sales: Confirmed. I’ll draft the renewal ask and risk one-liner.

elaine_cs: Great — if anyone spots a blocker that prevents delivery by Tue noon, post it here immediately and we’ll reassign. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
